# Feature Flag & Configuration Inventory

Intro text with `GP_*` constants.

## Class A — implementation selectors

| Property constant | Domain | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `GP_ALPHA_MODE` | `alpha` | selects the alpha **mode** |
| **GP_BETA_LIMIT** | beta | caps beta orders |
| `GP_UNKNOWN_FLAG` | `nosuch` | no such domain |
